items.title: Senegal Appoints Patrick Vieira as New Teranga Lions Head Coach
items.summary: Published by: The Fatu Network Senegal has officially named former France and Arsenal legend Patrick Vieira as the new head coach of the national team, ending weeks of speculation over who will take charge of the Teranga Lions. The Senegalese Football Federation said its Emerg...
